upstream.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.

classification.analysis: FreeToken is an edge-native MoE (Mixture-of-Experts) inference engine for running frontier-scale open-weight models (290B+ parameters) locally on consumer hardware like gaming PCs and laptops. Features semantic-aware caching, bandwidth-adaptive GPU-CPU co-execution, elastic memory management, and support for quantized formats (MXFP4, NVFP8, BF16). Distributed as both a desktop app with GUI and a CLI/Python package; compatible with Anthropic/OpenAI APIs for real-world agent integration.

use_cases.title: Run frontier MoE models locally on gaming PC without datacenter hardware
Serve large language models with low latency and dynamic memory allocation
Integrate local LLM inference into agentic systems via OpenAI-compatible API
Benchmark and tune inference performance with adaptive bandwidth management
Deploy open-weight models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM) at interactive speeds on consumer GPUs
